Traffic engineering

Traffic follows the shortest path by distance and link metric, and reroutes by itself when links fail. When a path is merely full, the overflow is dropped, just like a real IGP. From customer level 3 you can install Auto-TE in the NOC tab: it spills overflow onto up to two alternate paths with free capacity, as long as they are no more than twice as long.
Traffic takes the shortest path, even when it is full. A traffic-engineering controller spills the overflow onto the next-best paths with room.
Transit bills sample your usage every day and charge the 95th percentile of the last 30 days, so short spikes are forgiven but long ones are not.
